# Aconecto — Jongchan Ko

> Aconecto is a registered Korean software studio (since 2025) led by Jongchan Ko, a full-stack freelance software engineer. One owner takes a product from scope to release across web, mobile, backend, and cloud. Works in English, async across time zones, and usually replies within one business day.

## Positioning

- Implementation quality over spec or stack: how something is built matters more than what it's built with.
- One owner, end to end: scope, design, frontend, mobile, backend, and release all sit with one person — no handoffs, no lost context.
- Products, not just screens: API contracts, data models, deployment paths, and testing are owned too, so what launches actually runs in production.
- Safe to outsource to: registered business with formal contracts, NDAs, and tax invoices; confidentiality by default.

## Services

- MVP build — lean web, app, and API builds that reach real user validation quickly.
- Frontend systems — dashboards, admin tools, and product sites built for daily operational use.
- Backend & API — contract-first backends with deployable structure.
- Cloud & CI/CD — container builds, cloud hosting, release flows, and smoke tests.
- Technical rescue — auditing and stabilizing stalled or shaky codebases back to shippable.
